warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISKS OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: The warning says 'THE RISKS OF BIRTH DEFECTS', plural, where 27 CFR 16.21 says 'the risk of birth defects'. Confirmed on an enlarged crop.
The front's last line reads '22.4% ALC/VOL, 375mL', with a comma between the two declarations and no space in '375mL'.
